regime.method: 8 simple checks look at groups of markets over the last week and the last month. Each check votes risk-on (investors look comfortable owning riskier things), risk-off (investors look defensive) or neutral. The banner says risk-on or risk-off only when at least 60% of the checks that have data lean the same way and no more than 1 leans the other way; otherwise it says mixed.
regime.notice: A plain checklist of market groups, for research. It describes how markets behaved over the last week and month. It does not predict what comes next and it is not investment advice. No model chooses this label.

executive_summary.headline: Cross-asset money flows improve to mixed as equity sectors and crypto attract weekly volume, though broader regional indices and metals remain burdened by monthly outflows.
executive_summary.rotation_view: Across the month, money movement reflects an outflow-led stance, but trends are improving into mixed conditions over the week and day. Risk tone shifted from a monthly risk-off environment to mixed over the week. Weekly inflows favoured select equity sectors such as Indian banking and technology proxies, alongside US healthcare and Bitcoin. Conversely, regional equities including S&P five hundred and Nasdaq one hundred, alongside metals like Gold and Copper, experienced weekly outflows. Yields on two-year and ten-year Treasuries trended down.
executive_summary.drivers_view: Recent news coverage features discussions surrounding Nvidia leadership and restrictions regarding chip buyers and renters, alongside scrutiny over single-stock fund volatility. In banking, developments include trading updates regarding HDFC Bank as well as JPMorgan completing digital gold transactions. Central bank communications from the Federal Reserve addressed consumer credit regulations and discount rate minutes, while the European Central Bank addressed payment trends.
